ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels, characterized by high-frequency stochastic mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of white circular and irregular blobs (mottling) against a dark background across both lobes; highest concentration of white pixels is visible at the distal tips and along the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 42 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 5-15 units across the entire trailing edge; right lobe shows more severe jaggedness than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch tapering to sharp, caudally-extended distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white clusters (approx. 3-6 pixels in diameter) across the entire visible fluke surface, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified encrustation and significant jagged wear on the distal tips of both lobes, displaying a distinct yellowish-brown texture and high-contrast pixel intensity variation compared to the surrounding pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-intensity white focal spot located at the inferior margin of the left lobe near the median notch.
